messages:
Alex Chen: Heads up — saw a sharp reconnect spike from WebSocket consumers in eu-west-1 starting ~09:58 UTC. ~3x normal. Anyone else?
Priya Nair: Yup, noticed it at the same time. Console probe p50 jumped and sample fraction dropped.
Jamal Ortiz: I'm seeing a pattern in the logs where probe count goes to 0 then client retries 10-30s later. snippet: 
```
[2026-03-21T09:58:13Z] session=abc123 socket=svc-7 keepalive=300ms probe=0 -> close event
[2026-03-21T09:58:14Z] client_retry session=abc123 attempt=1
```
Marta Kowalski: That aligns with the probe-sampling heuristic v2 we rolled at 09:58 for canary. My suspicion: sampled probes are being treated as lease-neglect and evicted from sticky routing prematurely.
Alex Chen: canary rollout metadata? which shards got v2?
canary-bot: canary rollout "probe-sampling-v2" -> 25% at 09:58 UTC (regions: eu-west-1, eu-central-1)
Priya Nair: I pulled a routing trace for one of the affected sessions — sticky lease reassign at t+2s and probe-origin tag missing from trace. link: https://console.internal/traces/trace-1799 (internal)
Jamal Ortiz: Metering note: some reconnects show no quota debit but produced duplicate billing events later. suspect resume path re-emit.
Marta Kowalski: UX problem: console groups too many session ids under a single tenant row, hard to correlate probe rollouts with session churn. Propose adding a "probe-origin" column to the session table and an aggregated panel for probe-sample fraction by shard.
Alex Chen: +1 on probe-origin. Also we need quick triage: revert canary or tweak jitter.
Priya Nair: Opening INF ticket and dashboard task — INF-1234. Will add a temporary alert for sample-fraction < 0.2 and session-reconnect-rate > baseline*2.
Jamal Ortiz: Quick mitigation idea: restore previous sampling interval for canary back to baseline (keep latency changes minimal) while we run deeper trace. Canary traffic small so rollback should be quick.
Marta Kowalski: I'll prepare a rollback patch (restore probe-interval) and docs to land a runbook entry on lease-eviction heuristics.
infra-bot: deploy "probe-sampling-v2-rollback" -> rolled back from 25% to 0% at 10:45 UTC by Marta K.
Priya Nair: After rollback, reconnect rate dropped back to normal within two minutes. Monitoring panels look stable now. :tada:
Alex Chen: Nice. Follow-up: we need to capture a minimal repro and add a test for sticky-lease + probe-zero edge case in the routing sim harness.
Jamal Ortiz: Agreed — also add a meter check to ensure resume path always emits a single billing event.
Marta Kowalski: I'll write a short postmortem + runbook update, and add the probe-origin column to the console backlog.
Priya Nair: Created a short notes doc in INF-1234 and assigned follow-ups.
Alex Chen: Thanks all — great fast rollback. Will ping if we need further ops help.
Marta Kowalski: Filing the runbook PR after lunch.
Jamal Ortiz: Thx, closing loop from my side.
